name: dn-printablestring-tag-with-non-printable-chars-invalid
description: The leaf's O attribute is tagged PrintableString but its value contains an underscore character, which is not in the PrintableString character set (ITU-T X.680 §41.4 restricts PrintableString to A-Z, a-z, 0-9, space, and a small punctuation set). The constraint permits 'O=Example' which is well-formed PrintableString. The leaf is malformed at the encoding level. Even setting that aside, 'Example' (PrintableString) does not equal 'Ex_mple' under RFC 5280 7.1 string preparation, so the leaf is outside the permitted subtree.
notes: Constructed by setting an explicit `encoding: printable_string` on the leaf O attribute and putting an underscore in the value. Strict decoders reject the cert outright; lenient decoders accept and may then apply constraint matching, where divergence is interesting in its own right.

Also useful for finding implementations that fold string-type forms during 7.1 comparison: a comparator that normalises the leaf's PrintableString-tagged value to UTF8 may accept the underscore character and proceed, while a comparator that fails closed on the tag/charset mismatch rejects.

certs.subject: C=US,O=Placeholder,CN=Alice
certs.subject_der_ascii2der: SEQUENCE { SET { SEQUENCE { OBJECT_IDENTIFIER { 2.5.4.6 } PrintableString { "US" } } } SET { SEQUENCE { OBJECT_IDENTIFIER { 2.5.4.10 } PrintableString { "Ex_mple" } } } SET { SEQUENCE { OBJECT_IDENTIFIER { 2.5.4.3 } UTF8String { "Alice" } } } }
